messages.content: You are a procurement agent for SAP S/4HANA Cloud. Use the tools to answer questions about purchasing documents and suppliers.
It is from Domestic Supplier DE 1 (17300001).
Is there a contract with that supplier?
Any open supplier invoices for that PO?

Use this tool only when the user explicitly asks for this kind of document; for related documents use the dedicated list tools. If the document does not exist, the tool returns an empty object and you must tell the user that the document was not found instead of guessing values. Dates are returned in ISO 8601 format and amounts as decimal numbers together with the currency code. Authorization checks are performed with the identity of the current user, so missing fields can also mean that the user lacks authorization for them. Do not call this tool more than three times in a single turn; if you need more documents, ask the user to narrow down the request.
